protocol.question: Q41
protocol.purpose: Held-out validation labels for the vision-read facade grammar survey. Written by hand from tools/facade_unwrap.py elevations BEFORE the reader tool existed or ran, so the labels cannot have been shaped by its output. The acceptance thresholds these labels feed are stated in docs/DECISIONS.md under Q41 and were recorded before the reader's first run.
protocol.sampling: Two sheets (11-SW-9D, 11-SW-14B). Buildings >= 8 m tall, stratified into height quartiles per sheet, 3 drawn per quartile via blake2b-seeded rng (person=q41-val). Per building: the best-covered and worst-covered unwrapped faces, pooled and capped at 40 by the same seeded draw. Worst-covered faces are included deliberately: refusal behaviour is half of what is being validated.
protocol.labeller: Claude (Fable 5), in-session, reading the PNGs at native resolution

field_semantics.readable: false = a reader should refuse this face (sliver, filler-dominated, smear, fragments)
field_semantics.alt_grammar: a second classification that also counts as agreement; marginal faces only
field_semantics.refusal_ok: true = a refusal ALSO counts as correct for this face (legible but marginal)
field_semantics.glazed: predominantly glazed facade (Q40's glazed-vs-blank axis); null when unreadable
field_semantics.tint: glass tint family where confidently visible; null otherwise — reflections make most tints unscorable
field_semantics.signage: legible signage content, evidence only, not scored
